turns.input: Pellan gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Pellan fumbles with the worn leather boots tucked under his arm, ink-stained fingers trembling as he extends them toward Nicco. "I found these—well, I mean, they were being discarded, and your feet are—well, I noticed your shoes, sir, and thought perhaps—" He cuts himself off with a nervous swallow, spectacles slipping down his thin nose.

He presses the boots forward with desperate, almost apologetic energy, as if trying to offload something slightly embarrassing before anyone notices them speaking. The leather is scuffed but intact, clearly secondhand, sized for someone with larger feet than his own slight frame.

Nicco takes the boots from him.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration: Pellan blinks behind his thick spectacles, ink-stained fingers hovering uncertainly as Nicco extends the boots back toward him. "Oh—no, sir, I couldn't—" he stammers, shoulders hunching further. "They're quite worn, you see, hardly worth keeping, and your own shoes—" His voice trails off, gaze flicking toward Nicco's feet and away again. "Please, I meant them for you. I've no use for them myself."
